status: draft for the owner's edit (the third Tier-2 slice, 2026-09-13: on the hook under Amendment 2)
artist_scope: full contract (Tier 2, the gait-scaled (with an attacking branch and position writes) class: geckolib_migration_design.md section 5); ON THE HOOK until idle and walk are delivered (Amendment 2)
character_sheet: A huge hostile caterpillar: a head with a false head, two two-part tusks and two jaws; three front segments with side spikes, top spikes and legs; six rear segments with feet and spikes; a last segment with back spikes. It hunts along the ground. Read it as a spined caterpillar: the head bobbing (violently when it attacks), the jaws working, the front legs paddling, the rear segments stretching and bunching with its stride, the spikes rippling down its length.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.25 of the rig (halved on a play-nicely server) on a 256x512 sheet.

groups.name: jaws
groups.amplitude: +-0.139 rad rests, then pi x 0.025 = 0.079 rad (4.5 deg) at 1.3 x 0.22 at rest; pi x 0.07 = 0.220 rad (13 deg) at 1.7 x 0.22 attacking
groups.plain: the jaws work slowly at rest and snap fast and wide when attacking, mirrored
groups.math: a = attacking ? cos(t*1.7*0.22)*pi*0.07 : cos(t*1.3*0.22)*pi*0.025; ljaw.zRot = 0.139 + a; rjaw.zRot = -0.139 - a
groups.phase: the attacking flag selects the rhythm
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.22 (two float multiplies, left to right): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.286

groups.name: head_bob
groups.amplitude: 2 units at 0.3 x 0.22 at rest; 8 units at 1.7 x 0.22 attacking; the front segments take the bob divided by their index plus one
groups.plain: the whole head group rides up and down (a POSITION write): gently at rest, hard when attacking; the three front segments follow with a fading share
groups.math: headoff = attacking ? cos(t*1.7*0.22)*8 : cos(t*0.3*0.22)*2; Head/falsehead.y = -8 + headoff; tusks.y = -25 + headoff; jaws.y = -1 + headoff; seg1 parts.y = base + headoff/(i+1) + 8*i
groups.phase: the attacking flag selects the rhythm
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.3 x 0.22 (two float multiplies, left to right): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.066

groups.name: tusk_tips
groups.amplitude: +-0.802 rad rests, then pi x 0.08 = 0.251 rad (14 deg) at 2.11 / 2.3 x 0.22
groups.plain: the tusk tips flick about the vertical, each at its own rhythm
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 2.11 x 0.22 (two float multiplies, left to right): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.4642

groups.name: front_spikes
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.08 = 0.251 rad (14 deg) at 0.91 x 0.22, each segment a sixteenth turn behind
groups.plain: the front segments' side spikes ripple, mirrored
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.91 x 0.22 (two float multiplies, left to right): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.2002

groups.name: front_legs
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.04 = 0.126 rad (7 deg) at 0.35 x 0.22 at rest; pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) at 2.91 x 0.22 attacking; each segment a sixteenth turn behind
groups.plain: the front legs paddle gently at rest and thrash when attacking, mirrored
groups.math: a_i = attacking ? cos(t*2.91*0.22 + i*pi/8)*pi*0.15 : cos(t*0.35*0.22 + i*pi/8)*pi*0.04; seg1lleg_i.xRot = a_i; seg1rleg_i.xRot = -a_i
groups.phase: the attacking flag selects the rhythm
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.35 x 0.22 (two float multiplies, left to right): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.077

groups.name: stride
groups.amplitude: each rear segment sits 16 units behind the last plus cos(t x 1.7 x 0.22 + i x pi/4) x 1.5 x the walking speed, times its index; the last segment 16 units past the sixth
groups.plain: the six rear segments stretch and bunch along the body with the stride (a POSITION write scaled by the walking speed), the last segment trailing
groups.math: zdist_i = cos(t*1.7*0.22 + i*pi/4)*1.5*amount; seg2 parts_i.z = 39 + (16 + zdist_i)*i; seg3 parts.z = seg2_5.z + 16 (back spikes + 6)
groups.phase: the walking speed scales the stretch

groups.name: rear_spikes
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.07 = 0.220 rad (13 deg) at 0.4 x 0.22, each segment a sixteenth turn ahead
groups.plain: the rear segments' side spikes ripple down the body, mirrored
groups.math: seg2lspike_i.zRot = cos(t*0.4*0.22 - i*pi/8)*pi*0.07 (i = 0..5, the last segment i = 6); the right ones the negative
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.4 x 0.22 (two float multiplies, left to right): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.088

groups.name: back_spikes
groups.amplitude: pitch: -0.977 rad rest, then pi x 0.04 = 0.126 rad (7 deg) at 0.81 / 0.87 x 0.22; yaw: +-0.28 rad rests, then pi x 0.04 at 1.11 / 1.3 x 0.22
groups.plain: the two back spikes wave, each on its own pitch and yaw rhythms
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.81 x 0.22 (two float multiplies, left to right): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.1782

behaviour: This creature runs on its CLASSIC code (owner 2026-09-13, Amendment 2 to Amendment 1): its motion does not fit the exact transcription form, so the GeckoLib candidate poses it from the same formulas the classic renderer uses, and the shipped animation file carries NO clip. The self-gate opens when you deliver `idle` AND `walk` together (README rule, item 12); until then the game plays the classic code. The reference-only clip beside this sheet is that code sampled at fixed inputs - copy its timing, do not return it.

Many rhythms at wingspeed 0.22, three of them switched by the attacking flag; the rear segments' stride stretch is scaled by the walking speed (a gait on a position). The head bob and every segment's position are POSITION writes: a keyframed version needs position keys on the head group, the front segments and every rear segment. The port unrolls the 1.7.10 pose-and-draw loops into seg1_0..2 and seg2_0..5 copies (the reference row's reviewed re-expression).
The default renderer poses it from the classic code; the GeckoLib candidate sits behind the dev switch (-Dorespawn.dev.geckolibRenderers) and poses it from the same code until your clips arrive.

formulas: `CaterKillerModel.poseFrom` (CaterKillerModel.java:273-370, called from `setupAnim`; orig ModelCaterKiller.java:248-338, `render`, wingspeed 0.22 from `new ModelCaterKiller(0.22f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:499): (1) the jaw angle - attacking: the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.7 times 0.22, times pi, times 0.07; at rest the cosine of the age times 1.3 times 0.22, times pi, times 0.025 - the left jaw rolls by 0.139 radians plus it, the right by -0.139 minus it (orig :248-250); (2) the head bob - attacking: the cosine of the age times 1.7 times 0.22, times 8 units; at rest the cosine of the age times 0.3 times 0.22, times 2 units - the head and false head sit at -8 plus it, the four tusk parts at -25 plus it, the jaws at -1 plus it (POSITION writes, orig :251-259); (3) the left tusk tip yaws by 0.802 radians plus the cosine of the age times 2.11 times 0.22, times pi, times 0.08, the right by -0.802 plus the cosine of the age times 2.3 times 0.22, times pi, times 0.08 (orig :260-263); (4) for each of the three front segments i = 0, 1, 2: the segment and its spikes and legs sit at their base heights (-8, -32, -39, -8) plus the bob divided by i + 1 plus 8 times i, and at z -12 / -6 / -5 plus 14 times i (orig :273-286); the side spikes roll by the cosine of the age times 0.91 times 0.22 plus i times pi / 8, times pi, times 0.08, mirrored (orig :287-288); the legs pitch - attacking: the cosine of the age times 2.91 times 0.22 plus i times pi / 8, times pi, times 0.15; at rest the cosine of the age times 0.35 times 0.22 plus i times pi / 8, times pi, times 0.04 - mirrored (orig :289-291); (5) for each of the six rear segments i = 0 .. 5: a stretch of the cosine of the age times 1.7 times 0.22 plus i times pi / 4, times 1.5, times the walking speed; the segment and its six spike and foot parts sit at z = 39 plus (16 plus the stretch) times i (POSITION writes scaled by the walking speed, orig :300-308); the side spikes roll by the cosine of the age times 0.4 times 0.22 minus i times pi / 8, times pi, times 0.07, mirrored (orig :309-310); (6) the last segment and its parts sit 16 units past the sixth rear segment, its back spikes 6 more (orig :320-327); its side spikes roll on the rear spikes' rhythm with i = 6 (orig :328-330); its left back spike pitches by -0.977 radians plus the cosine of the age times 0.81 times 0.22, times pi, times 0.04, the right with 0.87; the left yaws by 0.28 plus the cosine of the age times 1.11 times 0.22, times pi, times 0.04, the right by -0.28 plus the cosine with 1.3 (orig :331-338). The walk position and the head angles play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (CaterKillerGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations, the positions through `moveTo`).
